12.

She also confirms the receipt of Rs 8,20,000/- as full and final settlement and submits that she has no claims or disputes against the petitioners and has no objection in case the aforesaid FIR is quashed.
13. This Court has perused the terms of settlement agreement and they appear to be lawful.
